name: responsive-scale-mixins
description: 🎨 SCSS mixins for perfect responsive design with universal browser compatibility. Supports ALL CSS units (px, rem, em, vw, vh, %, etc.) with pixel-perfect scaling and automatic static fallbacks for older browsers. Zero manual calculations - just flawless responsive typography, spacing, and dimensions across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Single-file distribution for maximum compatibility. Framework-agnostic and configurable design widths and optional clamp() bounds via Sass module configuration.
author: Saheed Odulaja
